subject: Moving tomorrow's call
text:
Hi,

Sorry to move this, but can we push tomorrow's call to later? I've been trying to follow the instructions you sent, but one part is fuzzy. You wrote to meet by the table with the flyers, and I can't tell if that means the main table or the smaller one beside the bulletin board. I was there once before and they look similar, so I don't want to show up in the wrong spot and make you wait.

By the way, I may have copied the wrong date in my head, so if you meant the week after the market day, tell me straight away. I can adjust quickly if needed.

Also, my schedule changed because I promised to help carry supplies after noon, but I think I can finish before then. If that's too early, let's pick another day. Maybe Thursday evening?

If you can reply with a clear time and the exact table, I'll mark it down. No rush. I think. Sorry for the extra back and forth.
